stem.en: Put the Hill's story in the order this Book told it.

text.en: A reaction is atoms re-gripping, and the balance checks every equation.
Bonds cost to break and pay to make; the difference is heat.
A hump blocks the way, and a catalyst lowers the hump but never the valley.
Free energy counts heat and ways together; every reaction runs to its valley floor.
One fall can be coupled to lift another, through a wheel.
A battery is a fall with a load; a flame is a fall with none.
